prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: desktop AI redesign concept bitmap for TALKPIK AI user app
Primary request: Create concept-03 for page 28-X-06-password-reset, state default. Reference state: simple password reset request screen. Create a minimal task-focused auth concept with no extra decoration.
Composition/framing: desktop 1280x900 edge-to-edge app UI screenshot only; no browser address bar, tabs, bookmarks bar, OS title bar, device frame, or watermark. No app sidebar. Center a small auth card beneath two functional icons and title. Card: short instruction, muted link-expiry line, email input, full-width Obsidian '재설정 링크 보내기' button. Below card: 로그인으로 돌아가기 link. Keep generous background but not a hero section.
Style/medium: high-fidelity Ant Design-friendly auth form, compact, clean, neutral, one task per screen.
Color palette: Mist/Snow/Fog/Obsidian; Obsidian #09090b for the only CTA; gray helper text; no gradients.
Typography: Cosmica-like modern sans, Korean UI text as visual direction only, no negative letter spacing, all button/input text fits.
Must preserve state signals: password reset request, empty email input, reset link CTA, expiry note, back to login link, no sidebar/browser chrome.
Avoid: browser chrome, OS frame, device frame, decorative image, colorful CTA, loud background, large card radius, heavy drop shadow.
